lockedFolders.reason: Exact approved NXG logo source only; no recolor, redraw, crop, or overwrite.

folderSemantics.intake: Uploaded candidates; not publicly promoted or eligible for posting.
folderSemantics.renders: Generated delivery variants tied to a source asset and render manifest.
folderSemantics.approved: Human-approved master media eligible for an explicit production promotion.
folderSemantics.production: Published website/campaign/ad assets; immutable public IDs, supersede rather than overwrite.
folderSemantics.quarantine: Failed or incomplete assets excluded from all routes and posting queues.
folderSemantics.archive: Retained historical media with source and campaign provenance.
folderSemantics.brand/locked: Reserved for the exact logo record; uploader cannot target this path.
